scheme_name: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student of class 10th or 12th
Applicant must be a top scorer at the district level in the respective board examination
Applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school in Madhya Pradesh
Eligibility category noted in source: backward class
benefits_summary: Monetary award of ₹5,000 for class 10th toppers and ₹10,000 for class 12th toppers
documents_required: self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents (if required)
